authority: Load-on-demand tactical detail; state/player-detail/combat-style.json owns the player doctrine.

purpose: stop pursuit or Body Flicker setup
setup: free-hand or katana angle after entry

purpose: compromise raised weapon or sealing arm

hands_and_fingers.deterministic_limit: Aiming at a hand does not bypass its movement, guard, armor, distance or contact timing.

neck_and_jawline.lethal_use: only after player declares lethal force and a legal opening exists

legal_attacks: katana threat to one wrist while controlling the other

break_seal: Pressure Nails attacks a finger or wrist
establish_control: move outside the weapon shoulder toward the blind side
finish: player chooses lethal cut or thrust, joint destruction, choke, throw, pin, disarm, cuffs or forced surrender
read: identify dominant hand, lead leg, weapon position, likely escape direction and sealing pattern
remove_mobility: attack or control ankle, Achilles, supporting leg, rear knee or hip position
trigger: advance, threaten a hand, throw a tool, take an angle or threaten the throat to force a reaction

disabling_sequence: remove mobility through ankle, Achilles, supporting leg or rear knee
establish wrist, elbow, shoulder, back or choke control
finish, pin, disarm or force surrender
force_melee_rules: remain close enough that sealing exposes the hands to the katana
follow retreat with Empty Step when geometry permits
shift physical attacks with Flowing Veil
deny escape lanes with Thousand-Edge routes
katana_and_free_hand_actions: turn the back or weapon shoulder
pull a limb across the body into a katana threat
legal_lethal_finishes: controlled neck cut from blind side
thrust through exposed armpit or torso after arm control
wrist disable followed by decisive body strike
rear-knee collapse followed by neck strike

multiple_opponents: do not remain attached to one target
prioritize sensors, medics, commanders, barrier users and large-scale casters
use Returning Current and Crosscurrent Zone
make one brief disable or throw
use Thousand-Edge routes to prevent interference
swordsman: use Listening Skin on swing startup
Pressure Nails attacks grip or wrist
control sword arm rather than repeatedly clash
taijutsu_specialist: disturb supporting ankle, knee, wrist or elbow
grapple only when angle and leverage are favorable

resource_decision_detail.cost_efficiency_rule: Prefer the lowest total chakra cost that produces the required legal effect, including setup, maintenance, likely follow-up costs, and the need to preserve a second-engagement reserve.
jutsu_use_tests: A physical answer cannot complete inside the actual timing window.
Range, terrain, airborne movement, sealing, barriers, or multiple opponents make a physical answer insufficient.
A low-cost method prevents substantially greater chakra loss, injury, capture, mission failure, or time loss.
Dodge, parry, block, cover, movement, or grappling cannot legally protect the required target.
The player explicitly orders the method or a chakra-expending tactical posture.
ordinary_priority_order: ordinary perception and intelligence-led threat analysis
position, timing, terrain, cover, and movement
standard katana, grappling, unarmed control, kunai, shuriken, wire, smoke, and explosive tags
low-cost jutsu that creates a necessary opening or prevents a greater cost
moderate-cost jutsu when physical methods are insufficient
major fields only with explicit player authorization except narrowly defined immediate survival emergencies
prohibited_default_uses: Do not maintain Listening Skin continuously without a concrete sensory need.
Do not use Empty Step when ordinary movement reaches the same legal position in time.
Do not use Pressure Nails when a physical feint, thrown tool, cut, grip, or footwork disruption is sufficient.
Do not sustain zones merely to dominate an already controlled opponent.
Do not add Wind Release for appearance, intimidation, or narrative spectacle.
Do not use Court of Ten Thousand Invisible Blades without explicit player authorization.
